_note: Register fragment for woo-document-assessment-screen (REQ-WDA-004). A person marks the redacted version of a partly public document verified before the batch can be published. The two fields are set by WooService::verifyRedaction() and cleared when a later assessment changes the redaction. Admin-only, as the rest of wooAssessment.

redactionVerifiedBy.description: The user id of the officer who checked the redacted version and marked it verified. Empty until a person did.
redactionVerifiedBy.title: Redaction verified by

redactionVerifiedAt.description: When the officer marked the redacted version verified.
redactionVerifiedAt.title: Redaction verified at
